title: English Practice Quiz 0017
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: How many syllables are in 'computer'?
questions.explanation: Computer is commonly pronounced with three syllables: com-pu-ter.

questions.question: If she studies, she ___ the test.
questions.explanation: Use will + base verb in the main clause of the first conditional.

questions.question: I ___ a new notebook yesterday.
questions.explanation: Yesterday signals the past simple. The past form of buy is bought.

questions.question: She is ___ university student.
questions.explanation: University begins with the consonant sound /y/, so use a.

questions.question: Read: 'Mina takes the bus at 8 a.m. and reaches work at 8:45.' How does Mina travel?
questions.explanation: The passage clearly says Mina takes the bus.

questions.question: If I were you, I ___ apologise.
questions.explanation: If I were you is followed by would for advice.

questions.question: There ___ two chairs in the room.
questions.explanation: Use are with the plural noun chairs.

questions.question: Please close ___ door.
questions.explanation: The refers to a specific door known to the speaker and listener.

questions.question: Read: 'The shop closes at 9 p.m., but it opens at 10 a.m.' When does it open?
questions.explanation: The opening time given is 10 a.m.

questions.question: Choose the passive form: 'They clean the room.'
options: The room is cleaned by them.
questions.explanation: Present simple passive: am/is/are + past participle.
